message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charge(s) based on fact. Fact: Defendant Wu set fire to bedding in his house to drive out intruders who were demanding debt. He burned property causing damage valued 3068 yuan. This is intentional destruction of property. The lexicon includes "故意毁坏财物" (intentional damage to property). Also possibly "聚众扰乱社会秩序"? He used fire to drive out people, but main act is intentional destruction of property. The prosecution cites Criminal Law article 114, which is about "故意毁坏财物罪". Indeed article 114 of PRC Criminal Law: "故意毁坏公私财物，数额较大或者有其他严重情节的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者罚金；数额巨大或者有其他特别严重情节的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑。" So charge is 故意毁坏财物.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物<eoa>
